description: City Plan 2014 — Coastal hazard overlay — Storm-tide is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Plan 2014 is Brisbane City Council's plan for the future development of Brisbane. Brisbane City Plan 2014 is regularly updated with new or amended information. To stay informed about City Plan, including proposed amendments and to receive other Council planning and development updates, you can register your interest. Coverage: Brisbane. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, city plan, coastal, hazard, protection. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2025-07-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
